AIR CONDITIONERS
•

Aug 14, 2023

Summers were hot, sticky....

Summers were hot, sticky, and full of open windows and box fans.

You learned where the breeze came in and which chair was coolest by evening.

Cold drinks, shade trees, and a hose in the yard did the job.

We didn’t complain much because that was just life.

You adapted, slowed down, and kept going.

Somehow, we slept just fine and woke up ready for another day.

It taught resilience and appreciation for simple comfort.
